formNote: A pictograph of a standing person seen from the side. As a component it is written 亻, as in 仁 and 信.
summary: A person, the human: in the Yijing the third of the Three Powers, standing between Heaven and Earth. The Shuowen calls it the most precious nature born of Heaven and Earth; Mencius says that humaneness, 仁, simply is being human.
placement: At the tip of the lower-right lobe: the human, the third of the Three Powers. (Placement is a design choice, not a claim.)

oc.note: † Baracus, from general knowledge; not yet checked against B–S 2014.

satellites.title: The Most Precious of Heaven and Earth
satellites.evidence: The Shuowen: 人，天地之性最貴者也 — “the person: of the natures born of Heaven and Earth, the most precious.” The graph is a pictograph of a person standing in profile.
